title: Additivity of spherical volume under free products in dimensions at least four

comparators.scope: 63 independently fixed explicit statements: all eight original conditional result wrappers plus 55 historical supporting targets.
One genuine extra-premise mutation of complementary_sqrt_bound, checked against the fixed original statement.
One genuine unauthorized-False-axiom mutation of complementary_sqrt_bound.

main_results.scope: Spherical-volume additivity for integer classes of countable free-product groups in every dimension n = k + 4, using current-mass infima.
Connected-sum additivity for closed connected oriented topological manifolds in dimension at least four, through their fundamental-group classes.
The two norm-folding approximate-tangent Jacobians sum to at most one, mass-almost-everywhere, for n ≥ 4, including zero strata.
The incident-edge vertex shadow on the unit sphere; branch routing agrees with deleted-vertex connectivity independently of endpoint choice.
The joint Jacobian bound for all vertex shadows of a finite tree, mass-almost-everywhere, for n ≥ 4.
Positive-degree quotient cycles admit homologous polyhedral approximations with arbitrarily small excess mass and exact prescribed polyhedral fillings.
Integer Bass–Serre transfers are well defined, commute with boundary and satisfy the joint mass bound in dimensions at least four.
Near-isometric deformation of a compact carrier, fixing the prescribed polyhedral support, with a compact-image Lipschitz homotopy.
Sharp mass approximation on finite spherical polyhedra, homologous fillings of vanishing mass, and exact prescribed polyhedral fillings.
